what_it_does: Applies a machine learning model called a Convolutional Autoencoder (CAE) to automatically detect problems in oscilloscope images captured during post-silicon validation. Post-silicon validation tests the actual physical chip to verify all functionalities and performance boundaries work correctly, producing enormous amounts of image and trace data. The CAE model learns patterns from real chip data to identify anomalies that indicate potential defects or issues without requiring manual inspection.
